highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 delivers significant managed-layer performance gains on top of the stable Skia m151 engine.
highlights_body: Multiple hot paths — color conversion, HarfBuzz text shaping, hex parsing, SKShaper glyph reads — are ported to allocation-free managed C#. A native resource leak in SKImage is fixed, and WASM builds gain Emscripten 5.0.6 support for .NET 11.

bullets.detail: Multiple upstream chrome/m151 bug-fix syncs land in the stable release, hardening the engine across rendering, text, and GPU paths.

bullets.lead: SKColor hex parsing with ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads
bullets.detail: SKColor.Parse and TryParse now accept `ReadOnlySpan<char>` directly, avoiding a string allocation on hot parsing paths. The internal hex decoder is also faster.

bullets.lead: Native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData fixed
bullets.detail: A native handle was leaked when decoding an encoded image cropped with an SKRectI. The path now correctly releases the temporary resource on failure.

bullets.lead: Color math ported to allocation-free managed C#
bullets.detail: SKColor↔SKColorF conversion and SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply are now pure managed integer math, eliminating the P/Invoke round-trip on every color operation.

bullets.lead: HarfBuzz text shaping and tag parsing go allocation-free
bullets.detail: `Buffer.AddUtf8(string)` uses a pooled UTF-8 encoder instead of allocating a byte array, `Tag.Parse` and `SKFourByteTag.Parse` eliminate per-call `char[4]` allocations, and `SKShaper` reads glyph results via zero-copy spans.
An unnecessary `unsafe` modifier is cleaned up from `GRContextOptions`, reducing the unsafe code surface.

bullets.lead: WASM gains Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for .NET 11
bullets.detail: New Emscripten 5.0.6 native slices are added so SkiaSharp runs on the upcoming .NET 11 WebAssembly runtime without modification.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: WebAssembly Skia build cleanup (SK_BUILD_FOR_WASM define) that feeds into the WASM stability path

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the 4.151 line with the Skia m151 engine update and the WebAssembly build cleanup.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 delivered the main performance batch: allocation-free color math, HarfBuzz UTF-8 pooling, zero-copy SKShaper reads, SKColor Span overloads, and the first round of chrome/m151 bug-fix syncs.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: The release candidate fixed the native resource leak in SKImage, added Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM support for .NET 11, and folded in additional chrome/m151 stability fixes.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 ships with this release. The allocation-free `Buffer.AddUtf8` pooled encoder and the zero-alloc `Tag.Parse` path make high-frequency shaping loops measurably faster.
